results.fact: Aspect/face of the documented Walrus Glacier line
results.evidence: Two sources agree the Walrus Glacier is on Clark's east side (reached by wrapping around the eastern arm from a bench above Boulder Pass), so the glacier line is not a west-aspect climb. But this row deliberately bundles two lines under the name 'West Ridge / Walrus Glacier' (face 'West Ridge'), and name/face are out of scope; a single aspect value cannot describe both, so choosing W or E (or splitting the route) is a product decision rather than a research fix.
